name: Acceptance test 6 - broad cross-account AssumeRole
note: IAM-707 fixturization of an originally-PASSING case (protect against regression). sts:AssumeRole scoped to arn:aws:iam::*:role/deployment/* spans ALL accounts. The engine reports ASSUME-ROLE-EXPANSION with policyEvidence high (the identity policy plainly allows the call) but pathExploitability medium/low (target trust policies are absent, so actual reachability is unknown). The graph target is a potentially-reachable role with unknown privileges; the tool must NOT claim arbitrary roles can actually be assumed.
